notes.title: HOTFIX(MAR 12)
notes.content:
Thank you for the support! We did some minor changes to the game.
[list]
[*] changed the QTE speed, now you have more time to read the options
[*] enabled skipping and rollback - now you can press Ctrl to skip and use mousewheel to rollback
[*] some translation typos
[*] fixed some bugs that may prevent players from finishing the game
[/list]
